text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOAAAAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...You're making too much of a fuss.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Did you guys have that much fun too? In 
this race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOAAAAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Is that a response to me? Or are 
you merely excited?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Damn it. To think I lost...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Ama-san.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Today—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Shut up!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare call that a "good match"! 
Don't think this is the end!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I will get stronger and stronger. More, 
and more, and more!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'll challenge you as many times as it 
takes! I'm not giving up on you, ever!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. You'll keep getting stronger, and 
you'll keep challenging me again and 
again.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I look forward to that day coming again.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I'm back, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It was an eventful year. Taking on the 
Classic Triple Crown, learning of the 
strength of others, training myself...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if next year will turn out to be 
this kind of year as well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I see. That sounds nice.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Now that I have tasted something this 
fascinating, there is no going back. I 
crave more."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer. Which race should we start off 
with next year?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Starting next year is the Senior tier. 
Regardless of whether or not we run in the 
prestigious Spring Shield, the Tenno Sho 
(Spring), I'd like to test the waters 
around the Hanshin Daishoten.
choice_data_list:
I'm thinking of registering for the 
"Hanshin Daishoten."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Understood. I leave the rest to you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Let me run even more.
